panels.title: Timed conditions
points: Task: the 'Walk to Learn' assembly speech
Texts and your plan in front of you

head: AO
Marks
Look for
rows: ideas from both texts, transformed, covering all bullets
speech form, direct address, persuasive tone for students
varied sentences, precise vocabulary, accurate punctuation

keywords.def: assessing a classmate's work against criteria
the standards used to judge work
using ideas from the texts (10 marks in Q8)
what went well and even better if

questions.q: Start the timer: write your speech (portal response box or paper).
Core (timed, 30 minutes): in the portal response box, write your 'Walk to Learn' assembly speech. Starter: 'Good morning, everyone.'
questions.a: A complete speech: all bullets covered with transformed ideas from both texts; speech form and persuasive register; accurate writing.

questions.q: Check (3 minutes): splices, homophones, paragraph breaks.
Peer mark a partner's speech (breakout pair): one WWW and one EBI per AO.
questions.a: Three WWW and three EBI linked to AO1, AO4, AO5.

questions.q: A speech copies three sentences from Text Two. Which AO suffers most?
options: AO1: ideas are lifted, not transformed
questions.a: B) AO1: ideas are lifted, not transformed. AO1 rewards selecting and transforming ideas; copying shows neither.
